overview.text: The earlier KEYRING AGENT address leads to KEYRING PRO's wallet homepage at keyring.app. Its agent section advertises market research, token transfers and liquidity-pool actions through an AI interface. The surrounding product is presented as a Bacoor-developed non-custodial Ethereum/EVM wallet with swaps, NFC backup and related tools. Account, Uniswap and chat panels are illustrations rather than a connected wallet or completed transactions. The page does not establish continued availability of the former standalone x402 execution service, fees or API. Security and open-source statements are publisher claims, not an independent code or custody audit. Transfers, swaps and liquidity actions involve assets, possible fees and market risk.
